scope: Explicit native-only classic column preference persistence on generated profiles; original live profile excluded
schema_rules: Strict version/incomplete/complete dictionaries; each pane exactly13 columns, full unique known-ID order and single known-ID sort with strict0/1 ascending; visible0/1; Name width absent, every other width16..8192; unknown private fields/namespace versions refuse overwrite
read_precedence: Valid private v1 wins; absent namespace falls back to reviewed original import; malformed/unsupported private data fails optional layout read without blocking library open
capture: Immutable bounded GUI snapshot of both panes; hidden remembered widths captured through a detached public Qt header state; Name remains Stretch and sampled width is omitted
save_trigger: Only View > Save current column layout; no autosave on resize/Reset/close/timer
baseline: Worker-owned pristine last successful layout-read bytes and source within a unique held-lease session; only unchanged existing Primary may save; bytes/presence conflict contract, not primary-inode CAS
storage: Existing ConfigFile transaction and .bak/.saving recovery filenames; no second profile/sidecar, no creation from Missing or recovery promotion; pre-existing saving preserved
opaque_preservation: Native edit replaces only private root value; every original untouched root key/value encoding and relative order is retained
cancellation: Check before synchronous save; after entering save return actual result including possible post-rename errors even when stop requested
async_edits: Acknowledgement never applies headers or changes selection/filter/details/library revision; newer per-pane revisions remain unsaved; failed/missing acknowledgement requires Reload before retry
reset: Construction-time native preview baseline remains local; only explicit Save persists it
java_compatibility: Pinned normal whole-map encoding retains native ASCII namespace semantically, may reorder/re-encode dictionaries; resetAllTables erases whole root including native map; native geometry/sort is not adopted by Java
limits_of_qualification: No original-profile or payload access; default preview still starts a fresh generated sample per launch
No Java registry/plugin effective-layout equality or native/Java shared column writer
No full client switching, network/plugin completion or whole-client performance claim
No stronger filesystem race/power-loss guarantee than the existing ConfigFile adapter
